implementation.implementation: True sixty-second periodic water with14/15/20 wave cycles,11/8 broad highlight cycles and bounded smooth drift.
Shared moving portal fronts projected onto actual steps and landing; subdued foreground blue rim.
Local source-cloud renewal in clear runs around fixed world bodies, ring, canopy and spires.
Separate far-basin air and near-ground streamers at different speeds, coupled to the gust envelope.
Broad interior cloth folds move and shade locally; outline, posts and joints remain fixed.
Original taut guyline vibrates with fixed endpoints; one selected scrub clump leans with the gust.
A few main-lantern dips with linked canvas/case response; path lamps stay predominantly steady.
Cool inner-ring material response from the same portal fronts; warm chevrons do not redial.
Perspective-mapped laptop route marker and modest status-line updates over the original map.
Small radio receive indicators at two review cues.
Confined left-handle mug repair, then light steam from the existing rim.
Generated RGBA expedition rover approaches on clear ground, parks, then reverses out; no gate crossing.

review_timing: Shared wind rises:9–25s and35–54s. Rover:enters7–18s, parks18–32s and reverses out32–44s. Radio:15s and43s. Lantern dips:26.4/26.75s and53.2s. Water and interactive light continue throughout.
caveats: The canopy uses interior folds; its free edge is intentionally fixed. The rover is an experiment, with a brief stationary hold and a reverse exit. Taut-line vibration is deliberately much smaller than cloth motion. The source mug has only its left handle repaired in a confined patch; the original source is preserved.
